offering.name: GeoCanon
offering.purpose: Jurisdictions, dial codes, flags, ISO codes, timezones, holidays, languages, currencies, and address formats for Django, in one package.

instructions: Agents should assume they do not have source-code access to a user's app unless explicitly granted. Use public docs, installed package APIs, user-provided examples, and browser-visible references. Treat jurisdiction, address, locale, and holiday behavior as configuration choices that should be verified with the user for regulated or legal workflows.

publicAccess.mcpEndpoint: geocanon-mcp stdio server installed with the package; python mcp/server.py from a source checkout

resources.name: overview
resources.title: Offering Overview
resources.description: What GeoCanon does and how agents should explain it.
resources.content:
# GeoCanon

GeoCanon is a Django toolkit for global-ready applications. It exposes consistent helpers for jurisdictions, dial codes, flag CSS classes, ISO country codes, timezones, holidays, languages, currencies, address formats, duration formatting, locale formatting, settings, forms, and middleware. Agents can help developers choose APIs, generate settings, design forms, verify localization assumptions, and map workflows to documented helpers without needing source-code access.

data.goal: Choose modules and optional extras needed for a global feature.
Generate GeoCanonSettings for defaults, timezone overrides, and language defaults.
Prepare Django form and middleware guidance for jurisdiction context.
data.approval: user reviews UX and default jurisdiction behavior

data.goal: Map address, phone, currency, and locale requirements to documented helpers.
data.approval: required before regulated/legal workflows rely on results

data.goal: Confirm country, timezone, holiday, currency, or language assumptions.
data.approval: recommended for customer-facing copy or compliance-sensitive behavior

resources.name: browser-surfaces
resources.title: Browser-Visible Surfaces
resources.description: Public browser surfaces agents can use without source-code access.

agentAssumptions: agent can read public docs and reference tables
agent cannot inspect a user's app unless user provides a browser or snippet
agent should ask before treating locale behavior as legal/compliance advice

confirm jurisdiction names/codes with package APIs
confirm customer-facing defaults with the user

auditHints: redact personal address and phone examples

arguments.name: user_goal
arguments.description: What the user wants to do with GeoCanon.

prompts.template: You are helping a developer with GeoCanon for: {user_goal}. Use public docs, installed package APIs, and user-provided examples. Do not assume source-code access. Ask for approval before customer-facing locale defaults or compliance-sensitive recommendations.

acceptanceChecklist: Agents can discover GeoCanon capabilities without source-code access.
All workflows map to public docs, package APIs, or user-provided examples.
Optional extras are documented for features that require them.
Browser workflows rely on public docs, PyPI, GitHub, or user-provided app sessions.
No workflow treats jurisdiction data as legal, tax, or regulatory advice without human approval.
